purpose: Operator selection examples consumed by tools/local_data/candidate_queue.py; not an authoritative source registry, source admission, or live discovery.

candidates.label: PRISM monthly, CONUS
candidates.coverage_note: Gridded historical context; provider warns against century-long trend calculations. Gaps and selected bytes unknown.

candidates.label: PRISM daily, CONUS
candidates.coverage_note: Provider catalog dates; observation completeness and revisions require discovery.

candidates.label: Landsat Collection 2 and MSS archive
candidates.coverage_note: MSS 1972-1999; TM from 1982; Landsat 8/9 ongoing. Sensors/products are not interchangeable. Latest scene and gaps unknown.

candidates.label: Annual NLCD C1.2, CONUS
candidates.coverage_note: Annual classified land cover; provider version C1.2. Local completeness unknown.

candidates.label: USDA Cropland Data Layer, CONUS
candidates.coverage_note: Complete CONUS program coverage from 2008; discover earlier Kansas metadata separately. 30 m to 2023, 10 m from 2024. 2025 national ZIP 9.8 GB at 10 m or 1.9 GB resampled 30 m; selected-area bytes unknown.

candidates.label: USGS water records: full station periods
candidates.coverage_note: Dates vary per site, parameter, statistic, and series; metadata envelopes do not prove gap-free coverage.

candidates.label: USGS 3DEP terrain and lidar
candidates.coverage_note: Work-unit acquisition dates require provider metadata. Public EPT only; original raw LAZ Requester Pays route excluded.

candidates.label: JRC Global Surface Water v1.5
candidates.coverage_note: Merge original pre-2016, corrected 2016-2021 and 2022-2024 histories. C1/C2 alignment offsets and monthly recurrence issue; exact gaps unknown.

candidates.label: ERA5 hourly global reanalysis
candidates.coverage_note: Reanalysis rather than station observations; catalog endpoint verified, actual query completeness unknown.

candidates.label: ERA5-Land hourly global land
candidates.coverage_note: Model-derived; accumulation conventions and documented swapped evapotranspiration components require validation.

candidates.label: TerraClimate monthly global land
candidates.coverage_note: CC0, model-derived water balance; inherited long-term trends and limited fine-scale variability.

candidates.label: CHIRPS v2 final, 50S to 50N
candidates.coverage_note: Quasi-global precipitation; excludes polar regions. Actual query gaps unknown.

candidates.label: Sentinel-2 harmonized TOA
candidates.coverage_note: Top-of-atmosphere reflectance; do not silently merge with surface reflectance. Cloud masks change over time.

candidates.label: Sentinel-2 harmonized surface reflectance
candidates.coverage_note: Ongoing collection; 2017-2018 coverage is not globally complete. Latest exact scene and local gaps need discovery.

candidates.label: Sentinel-1 GRD radar
candidates.coverage_note: Match polarization, orbit and acquisition mode; no requester-pays raw Google mirror.

candidates.label: NOAA GHCN daily station history
candidates.coverage_note: Full periods vary per station and element; global date ranges must not be assigned to each Kansas station.
